declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty content scope: factory workflow rules govern work throughout the repository. The canonical .scriptorium/config.json is owned by its separate exact declaration. Existing .factory/config.json and src/factory-configuration.ts establish the migration context.

Intentionally empty content scope: remote fixes reconcile GitHub settings; read-only checks validate repository-owned policy without editing it. Authenticated gh confirms PUBLIC lutzseverino/scriptorium, user-owned with no organization inheritance, and repository REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON absent (hosted default); only REPO_CANON_UPDATES=true is set. This adoption request authorizes CLI-ready remote setup. Main bd69471157fd70b81015ce60cfca4c217c627a88 supplies the approved required-check policy naming PR metadata and Test.

Intentionally empty: the repository holds one package, `@lutzseverino/scriptorium`, whose only manifest is the root package.json, with src/ and test/ at the root and no workspace or build configuration naming another component. The package is the repository itself, so its README is the root README.md, which the repository-readme declaration owns; there is no non-root Project and so no non-root README to propose. The README.md files under docs/ are documentation indexes owned by the documentation scope.

Drafted from manifests and workspace configuration by `discovery/draft-typescript-astro-stack-scope.mjs`: one `package.json` per Project, included when it matches the stack's manifest facts and excluded naming its differences otherwise. A maintained workspace root package is a Project alongside its members; a shared-only root is not. Uncertain root membership stays unresolved. A root package without workspace members is a Project. The repository holds no matching web Project, so the declaration has no scope.

candidates.reason: `package.json` has no evidence of membership in typescript-astro; assess independently, without assigning a web stack from tool conformity alone.

declarations.coverage: The sole root package @lutzseverino/scriptorium is the repository Project: package.json names start, typecheck and tests over src/ and test/, and there are no workspace members. Toolchain PR #56 is merged. The manifest and pnpm-lock.yaml match pnpm 11, Node 24/26, oxlint 1, Prettier 3 and validate. TypeScript 7.0.2, node --test, required CI Test aggregating both Node jobs running pnpm validate, and docs/development/README.md Setup and validation establish the contextual stack rules. Copied source inputs and fixture packages are not Projects.
